# Field boundaries for Switzerland

Switzerland field boundaries (2025) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Konferenz der kantonalen Geoinformations- und Katasterstellen. License: other.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ch/latest/ch.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ch/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:2056; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: collection, crop:name, hcat:name, hcat:name_en, admin:subdivision_code, id, geometry, hcat:code, metrics:area, determination:datetime, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ch/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ch/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ch/collection.json
